model_explanation: the focus on “ELLEN” means S1 says Ellen is the only person Sam gave bananas to; it does not restrict what Sam gave Ellen. S2 says Sam gave Ellen something else (grapes), which is compatible, so S2 is independent, not entailed or contradicted.

the focus on “MARY” means S1 says Mary is the only person Sam gave apples to; it does not restrict what he gave Mary. S2 claims about oranges, which are not constrained by S1’s focus, so S2 is independent.

with focus on “TOM”, S1 says Tom is the only person who got bananas. It doesn’t say Sam did not give Tom other things. S2 talks about Tom getting apples, which S1 neither entails nor denies, so S2 is independent.
focusing “MARY” makes S1 say Mary is the only person who got apples, not that apples are the only thing Mary got. S2 is about grapes to Mary, which S1 leaves open, so S2 is independent.
focus on “ORANGES” makes S1 say oranges are the only thing Sam gave Mary. That excludes apples to Mary, so S2 is entailed.

focus on “APPLES” makes S1 say apples are the only thing Sam gave Rob, not that Rob is the only apple-recipient. Thus S1 allows Sam to give apples to Mary too, so S2 is compatible, not contradicted or entailed.
with focus on “ROB”, S1 says Rob is the only person Sam gave apples to. S2 says Tom also got apples, which directly violates this, so S2 is contradicted.
focusing “ORANGES” means oranges are the only thing Sam gave Rob. That rules out bananas to Rob, so S2 is entailed.
focus on “GRAPES” says grapes are the only thing Sam gave Bill, not that Bill is the only person who got grapes. S1 allows giving grapes to Rob, so S2 is independent, not contradicted or entailed.
